example_sentence: Please come to the table.|Come sit with your friends.|Can you come help me?
We play outside after lunch.|Let’s play a game after dinner.|Do you want to play with the blocks?
Can you find your shoes?|Find the red crayon in the box.|Help me find the missing puzzle piece.
Let’s make a cake together.|Make sure to stir the batter.|Can you make a tall tower?
Where is my red hat?|Tell me where you put your book.|Where did the puppy go?
I can run faster than you.|Run to the finish line.|Please do not run in the hallway.
The little dog barked loudly.|She held a little kitten.|This little cup is for you.
The cat sat on the mat.|Pet the soft cat gently.|The cat likes to nap in the sun.
The ship sailed away.|We watched the ship leave the dock.|A big ship carries many people.
She wore a shiny ring.|The bell will ring at noon.|Please ring the doorbell once.
The moon is bright tonight.|Look at the full moon.|The moon shines over the lake.
He sat in the wooden chair.|Pull up a chair and sit.|The chair rocked back and forth.
Please open your book to page five.|Read a book before bed.|The book has colorful pictures.
He swung the bat at the ball.|Hang the bat costume on the hook.|A bat flies silently at night.
She gave the dog a gentle pat.|Pat the dough flat.|Give your friend a pat on the back.
The pen is on the desk.|Use a blue pen to write.|Click the pen to open it.
The pan is on the stove.|Cook the eggs in the pan.|Wash the pan after dinner.
The ship left the harbor.|A ship can sail across the sea.|The ship sounded a loud horn.
The sheep grazed in the field.|Count the fluffy sheep.|A sheep gives us warm wool.
He bit into the apple.|Take a small bit of the cookie.|The horse bit fits gently in its mouth.
The drum beat was loud.|You can beat the eggs quickly.|Listen to the beat of the song.
